name: Lv1 Yuusha ga Megami Jashin to ♀ Monster Hanshoku Keikaku Hajimemashita!
original_name: Lv1勇者が女神・邪神と♀モンスター繁殖計画始めました!
source:
Long ago monster women populated the entire world. Today they live hidden lives in dwindling numbers.
To rectify the situation a good and evil goddess take the hero on a quest to mate, impregnate and breed!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ108676.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
远古时代，魔物娘曾遍布整个世界；然而时至今日，数量锐减的她们只能隐姓埋名、偏安一隅。
为了扭转这一濒危局面，善良女神与邪神联手带领勇者踏上了交配、受孕与繁衍后代的壮阔征途！！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ108676.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
